name: EuroSAT
description: 27,000 labelled Sentinel-2 patches across 10 land-use and land-cover classes, sampled from 34 European countries. The hub's split_v2 keeps the v1 partition (70/10/10/10, stratified per class, seed 42) but replaces filename ids — which leaked the label — with content hashes. Modern backbones cluster at 98–99%, so read the confidence intervals, calibration and the EuroSAT-C robustness track to tell them apart.
citation: Helber, Bischke, Dengel, Borth. EuroSAT: A Novel Dataset and Deep Learning Benchmark for Land Use and Land Cover Classification. IEEE JSTARS, 2019.

metrics.name: accuracy
metrics.label: Accuracy
metrics.description: Fraction of hidden-split images whose predicted label is correct.

metrics.name: f1_macro
metrics.label: Macro F1
metrics.description: Unweighted mean of per-class F1 — every class counts equally.

metrics.name: balanced_accuracy
metrics.label: Balanced acc.
metrics.description: Mean per-class recall; robust to class imbalance.

metrics.name: cohen_kappa
metrics.label: Cohen's κ
metrics.description: Agreement with ground truth corrected for chance agreement.

metrics.name: top2_accuracy
metrics.label: Top-2 acc.
metrics.description: True class among the two most probable (needs probabilities).

metrics.name: ece
metrics.label: ECE
metrics.description: Expected calibration error, 15 equal-width confidence bins: how far confidence is from accuracy (needs probabilities).

metrics.name: nll
metrics.label: NLL
metrics.description: Mean negative log-likelihood of the true class (needs probabilities).

metrics.name: brier
metrics.label: Brier
metrics.description: Mean squared error between the probability vector and the one-hot truth (needs probabilities).

columns.name: sample_id
columns.description: content-hash id from the public split manifest

columns.name: prob_<class>
columns.description: optional — one column per class in canonical order, floats in [0, 1] summing to 1; enables calibration metrics
